messages.subject: predict
parts:
Dear unmarked ones,

 

I fit a dynamic occupancy model using colext(). The model has effects of year, elevation and forest cover plus a few polynomials and interactions of elevation and forest cover. Now I want to get predictions for year, but failed:

 

> nd <- data.frame(year=factor(c('1999','2000','2001','2002','2003','2004','2005','2006','2007')),
+    elev = rep(0, 9), forest = rep(0, 9))
> E.ext <- predict(fm24, type='ext', newdata=nd)
Fehler: ncol(coefficients) == length(obj@estimates) is not TRUE
> E.col <- predict(fm24, type='col', newdata=nd)
Fehler: ncol(coefficients) == length(obj@estimates) is not TRUE

What is wrong ?

 

Thanks a lot and kind regards --  Marc

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] predict
parts:
Hi Marc,

If there were 9 years of data, then I think you need to create a data.frame with only the first 8 years. Does this work:

nd <- data.frame(year=factor(c('1999','2000','2001','2002','2003','2004','2005','2006')),
                        elev = rep(0, 8), forest = rep(0, 8))


The last year of data is ignored by colext when modeling the col/ext parameters. The documentation probably isn't clear about this.

Richard
